name: currencyguard-guard-pricing
description: Price and explain CurrencyGuard invoice-linked FX protection through a read-only MCP workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Invoice-linked FX protection pricing and explanation.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to CurrencyGuard's public Streamable HTTP MCP to retrieve indicative spot and forward rates, price invoice-linked Guard protection, resolve settlement dates, model historical FX stress, list supported currencies, and explain the product. The plugin is read-only at packaging time and does not execute trades, convert currency, bind a Guard, provide financial advice, or make eligibility decisions.
defaultPrompt: Price CurrencyGuard protection for this invoice exposure.
Show spot and forward FX rates for this payment scenario.
Explain CurrencyGuard's invoice-linked protection and caveats.
